boon.description: Add 1 recharge token to any of your currently recharging Bright Order spells.

conservative.requirements: 7 power. Target engagement within medium range. For each character in the target engagement beyond the first, add {Dc} to the dice pool. Effect: Roaring flames form a cage around the target engagement while this card is recharging. Characters who enter or leave the engagement suffer damage as described.

success.description: You cast the spell. Any character that passes through the flames suffers 4+Int+WP damage.
As above, and one target in the engagement is immediately hit for Int+WP damage.
